restatements.text: Repeals the existing prohibition on abortions after 15 weeks of gestation and makes abortion legally permissible at any time prior to fetal viability.

findings.quote: The 15-week limit on abortion is repealed. Abortion is lawful at any point before fetal viability.
findings.mechanism: Expands access to abortion by removing the 15-week gestational limit, allowing the procedure up to the point of fetal viability.

findings.quote: The 15-week limit on abortion is repealed. Abortion is lawful at any point before fetal viability.
findings.mechanism: Removes legal restrictions on abortion between 15 weeks of gestation and fetal viability.

analysis.answer: Under current law, abortions are prohibited after 15 weeks of gestation, except to prevent the pregnant woman's death or a serious and irreversible impairment of a major bodily function. This measure removes the 15-week ban and allows abortion for any reason up to the point of fetal viability.

Individuals seeking an abortion between 15 weeks and viability will be able to access the procedure locally rather than having to travel to another jurisdiction or carry the pregnancy to term. Medical providers will likely expand their services to accommodate patients up to the viability threshold.

Pregnant individuals gain the legal discretion to choose an abortion up to the point of viability. Medical providers gain the authority to perform the procedure during this timeframe without having to certify that the pregnant woman's life or major bodily functions are at risk.

flags.note: The measure establishes a limit based on "fetal viability" but does not define the term or specify who is authorized to determine when viability is reached.

items.text: Expanded legal access to abortion up to the point of fetal viability.
Legal protection for the fetus between 15 weeks of gestation and fetal viability.
The existing prohibition on abortion after 15 weeks of gestation, with limited exceptions.
The legal right to access an abortion at any point before fetal viability.
